function.arguments: {"finding": "The channel is strongly confounded with customer_segment. The email channel has 132 loyal and 134 returning customers, but only 64 new customers. In contrast, paid_search has 306 new customers, 153 returning, and only 26 loyal. Since loyal and returning customers have higher conversion rates than new customers, the raw comparison between channels is confounded: the email group is composed of higher-value customers, which inflates its conversion rate regardless of the campaign. This violates the requirement to compare comparable groups.", "implication": "We cannot report the raw difference in conversion rates. We must adjust for customer_segment. The correct method is stratification: compute conversion rates within each segment, then compute the difference in those rates. This isolates the campaign effect from the selection bias in targeting."}
function.name: note_finding
